title: Apple denies iPhone import ban in China
text: Apple denies iPhone import ban in China Monday, 10 December 2018 ( 3 hours ago ) Chip-maker Qualcomm says it has won an injunction against Apple in a continuing dispute over intellectual property. ▶ Apple Hopes HomePod Will Be A Success In China 00:32 The Apple HomePod will launch in China in early 2019, according to Digital Trends. The HomePod will support both Mandarin and Cantonese dialects of the Chinese language. The HomePod will be available in white or deep gray for approximately $407. Apple is hoping the HomePod will be a success in China,... Recent related videos from verified sources Qualcomm said a Chinese court granted the company two preliminary injunctions against Apple.
